notes: Apollonius Rhodius' Argonautica, a clean Teubner-style polytonic Homeric-dialect edition (test split). The verse lines read correctly with all breathings and accents; the high OOV share is just the epic vocabulary. Running titles (24-34, 36, 38) and apparatus lines (17, 35, 37: sigla like 'G Vatt.', 'Paris. unus', 'L G') also match the print. Isolated slips: line 1 renders the capital's breathing+accent as '‘*Αλλα', line 2 appends 'white' from a handwritten margin note, and line 21 uses Latin 'A' for the book numeral Α.
